A [[Duros]] '''attache''' of [[Imperial Guard]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Calum]] was present during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was stationed aboard [[Proculus Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Around [[3641 BBY]], he tasked an Imperial traveler to talk to Commander Calum about the freeing of the [[Dread Masters]] from [[The Tomb]].<ref name="TOR" />
